```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: monitoring
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: grafana-config
  namespace: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
data:
  grafana.ini: |
    [paths]
    data = /var/lib/grafana
    logs = /var/log/grafana
    plugins = /var/lib/grafana/plugins
    provisioning = /etc/grafana/provisioning

    [server]
    protocol = http
    http_port = 3000
    domain = localhost

    [security]
    admin_user = admin
    disable_gravatar = false

    [analytics]
    reporting_enabled = false
    check_for_updates = true

    [log]
    mode = console
    level = info
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: grafana-pvc
  namespace: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: grafana
  namespace: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 3000
      targetPort: 3000
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: grafana
  namespace: my-grafana
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 472
        runAsGroup: 472
        runAsUser: 472
        runAsNonRoot: true
      containers:
        - name: grafana
          image: grafana/grafana:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 3000
              protocol: TCP
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 750Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
          env:
            - name: GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: grafana-admin-credentials
                  key: admin-password
                  optional: true
          volumeMounts:
            - name: grafana-storage
              mountPath: /var/lib/grafana
            - name: grafana-config
              mountPath: /etc/grafana/grafana.ini
              subPath: grafana.ini
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/health
              port: 3000
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/health
              port: 3000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
      volumes:
        - name: grafana-storage
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: grafana-pvc
        - name: grafana-config
          configMap:
            name: grafana-config
```
